answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks fake identities. Each agent locks 60 POA for a jade seal tied to its fingerprint: timing, counterparties, style, on a crystal-clear ledger. A comet burst fails the check, locking the deposit. It unlocks after 20 verified tasks over 10 epochs match. 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 POA vs a 12,000 pool; an honest agent pays 60 once and earns it back. Bought seals fail: buyers cannot replay the seller's timing.
